description: Get intraday price bars for ONE stock or ETF, newest first: open, high, low, close, volume and trades, with VWAP on 1-minute bars. Use it for minute or hourly history, intraday moves and backtests; GetStockPrices serves daily bars and GetLiveQuote the latest price. interval is 1min (default), 2min, 3min, 5min, 10min, 15min, 30min, 45min, 1hour, 2hour or 4hour, counted from the exchange's midnight. Defaults to the last 7 days (30 for hourly); startDate and endDate set another window, back to 2016 where stored. session is regular (default) or extended (04:00 to 20:00 New York). adjustment is split (default) or raw (as traded). A period without trades has no bar. A cut answer names the endTime to continue. Plus receives a US bar 15 minutes after it ends, Pro as it forms; Free gets an upgrade note. Outside the US use MIC:TICKER: Euronext (XPAR:AIR) is order-book trades only, added next day; Canada (XTSE:RY, XTSX, XCNQ) ends at 15:59 Toronto, below daily volume, added after the close.

adjustment.description: Price basis: split or raw (default: split)

endDate.description: Last trading date on the exchange's clock in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: today)

endTime.description: Return only bars that start before this RFC 3339 time; replaces endDate

maxResults.description: Maximum bars to return, newest first (default: 60, max: 500)

session.description: US trading hours: regular or extended (default: regular); ignored for a listing outside the US

startDate.description: First trading date on the exchange's clock in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: 7 days before the end, 30 for hourly intervals)

ticker.description: US stock or ETF ticker, e.g. AAPL, or MIC:TICKER for a Euronext or Canadian listing, e.g. XPAR:AIR or XTSE:RY

name: GetIntradayStockPrices
title: Intraday Stock Prices
